required_stages: join CpG coordinates, methylation fractions and chromosome lengths
apply extreme-methylation thresholds
deduplicate genomic sites across samples

tasks.assessment: The observed Anolis task joins all supplied age-associated CpG dyads to 37 sample methylation columns and matched AnoSag2.1 scaffold lengths, applies strict <10% or >90% thresholds, counts unique extreme sites per scaffold, divides by reference bases, and averages only scaffolds with at least one filtered site. Native and Harbor oracle/artifact checks passed. This validates the Verified question's complete operation in an independent biological context, not the Jackdaw numerical answer.
scientific_decisions: Deduplicate filtered loci and average chromosome-specific densities only over eligible chromosomes; a pooled genome-wide density has a different denominator.
remaining_gaps: This uses independent Anolis GEO observations and AnoSag2.1 rather than the original avian Dryad inputs; source numerical answers are not reproduced. Broad release-level benchmark-lineage review and training weighting remain separate.
